sahneler.metin: In fog off Newfoundland, the liner Arctic collided with a smaller steamer.
It sank hours later, and only eighty eight people survived.
The captain first tried to help the other ship.
Then he found his own hull holed below the waterline.
He ran for land, but the engines stopped.
There were lifeboats for fewer than half aboard.
Order broke down, and crew took many of the places.
All the women and children aboard died.
